en.html:
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ａ"Relief?"
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ｂ"Yes. Good work."
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ａ"Exhausting work. Finally sleep."
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ａ"As if the Yamato fellows had energy for a night raid after today’s beating. Packing to run, more likely. Could do without sentries entirely."
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ｂ"Even so, no guards at a night camp? Unthinkable."
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ａ"I know. Your turn, then."
ｅｔｃ／歩哨Ｂ"Yes. Rest well."
